label: early-episode D2 state readout (stronger for S2 or after an unrewarded trial)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (96.5% of activation mass), and only in the first ~30 trials of an episode. Rate is about 28% in trials 0-9 and 21% in 10-19, then drops to ~0 after trial 40, so this unit is mostly an early-episode / time-in-episode signal. Within early D2 it prefers reaching S2 (75% of mass vs 21% for S1) and trials after an unrewarded trial (prev_reward 0). Phase + ep_trial<20 alone gives dev F1 0.68 (mass recall 0.81); adding (state==S2 | prev_reward==0) with ep_trial<25 raises it to F1 0.75, mass recall 0.83. Activation is larger earlier in the episode: the top quartile is the one most covered by the ep_trial window. Never fires at D1 or when the reward input is 1, and rarely at GO (3.5% of mass). It is not selective for transition type, this trial reward, or stay/switch. All variables are observed at D2 (state is shown, prev_reward was seen at D1), and episode time can be inferred from the hidden state.
